result.coreMessage: Show home brewers how to use the printed roast date and the dark cherry and cocoa note to brew the single-origin bag roasted in Aarhus after their order.
result.hook: Sådan smager du mørk kirsebær i kaffe
result.visualDirection: Overhead photo of a kitchen table in soft autumn daylight: hands holding open a plain bag with blank side to camera showing coffee beans inside, a ceramic cup of black coffee beside it, and two small bowls with dried dark cherries and broken cocoa pieces; calm and still; no letters, text, numbers, logos or words visible anywhere.
result.headlineDa: Bryg posen fra Aarhus og find mørk kirsebær og kakao
result.headlineEn: Brew the Aarhus bag and taste dark cherry and cocoa
result.primaryTextDa: Sådan prøver du det: 1. Se ristningsdatoen på posen. 2. Bryg din single origin som du plejer. 3. Smag efter mørk kirsebær og kakao. Din næste pose ristes i Aarhus først efter din ordre, og du kan springe en uge over.
result.primaryTextEn: How to try it: 1. Check the roast date on the bag. 2. Brew your single origin as usual. 3. Taste for dark cherry and cocoa. Your next bag is roasted in Aarhus only after your order, and you can skip a week.
